title: ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE POLICE UNIFORMS AND EQUIPMENT REGULATION ACT [ANNEX 1]
title_original: 경찰제복 및 경찰장비의 규제에 관한 법률 시행규칙 [별표 1] 경찰장비
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE POLICE UNIFORMS AND EQUIPMENT REGULATION ACT
ANNEX 1 — POLICE EQUIPMENT (Related to Article 2)
<Revised December 31, 2021>

1. POLICE HANDCUFFS
Classification / Figure / Form, dimensions and markings / Remarks

(a) Steel handcuffs.
For the National Police Agency:
(1) On the front of the body, engrave the numbering sequence [KNP – year (two digits) – handcuff model number (two digits) – serial number (five digits) – manufacturer name].
(2) Engrave the police emblem on the rear of the body.
(3) Emboss the manufacturer name in Korean on the key.
For the Korea Coast Guard: the form and specifications follow those of the National Police Agency's steel handcuffs, except that the serial number is not displayed.
For the Jeju autonomous police corps: omit the National Police Agency police-emblem engraving; engrave on the front of the body a serial mark such as “JMP 0000”.
Materials: the handcuff body is made either of SM45C under KS D 3752 or SS400 under KS D 6701 as prescribed in the source remarks.

(b) Fixed-type handcuffs.
(1) Engrave on the front the numbering [KNP – year (two digits) – handcuff model number (two digits) – serial number (five digits) – manufacturer name].
(2) Engrave the police emblem on the rear of the body.
(3) The housing of the body is black polycarbonate.
(4) Housing dimensions: length 155 mm ± 5 mm; width 36 mm ± 5 mm.
The handcuff body is made of SM45C according to KS D 3752.

(c) Single-hand handcuffs.
(1) Engrave on the front the numbering [KNP – year (two digits) – handcuff model number (two digits) – serial number (five digits) – manufacturer name].
(2) Engrave the police emblem on the rear.
(3) The handcuffs and lock shall use the same key; the chain shall be stainless steel and its length at least 800 mm.
The handcuff body is made of SM45C under KS D 3752.
Figures and original drawn forms for all classifications are those shown in the Korean-source annex.

2. POLICE SHIELDS
Classification / Figure / Form, dimensions and markings / Remarks

(a) Police shield.
(1) At the center of the shield body display the Korean word “경찰” in HY Headline Medium and “POLICE” in HY Gyeon Gothic. Both marks are white and printed by silk-screen.
(2) The plate is translucent dark gray with a bluish tint (dark grade color).
The shield is produced by injection molding, using polycarbonate as its raw material.

(b) Coast Guard shield.
(1) At the top center of the plate display the Coast Guard emblem (OI).
(2) Cut a high-density shock-absorbing foam sponge measuring 520 mm × 700 mm × 20 mm and affix it to the front so that it cannot come away.
The shield is injection-molded from polycarbonate.

(c) Plainclothes-police shield.
(1) Affix a blue film for the sponge cover to the rear of the shield.
(2) Place the white markings “경찰” and “POLICE” between the body and the adhesive film, at the center.
The shield is made using polycarbonate.
Design/figure cells are to be read with the original Korean annex.

3. POLICE PISTOL BELTS
Classification / Figure / Form, dimensions and markings / Remarks

(a) Leather pistol belt.
(1) The holster and handcuff pouch are cut from leather.
(2) The maker and manufacturing year/month/day shall be clearly stamped by hot embossing on the rear of the holster.
Produced in black or brown.

(b) Synthetic-fabric pistol belt.
(1) Use Cordura 1000D fabric for the shoulder pad and cut to shape.
(2) Clearly emboss the manufacturer and date of manufacture on the back of the holster.
Produced in black.

4. NATIONAL POLICE AGENCY CARS AND MOTORCYCLES (WARNING LIGHTS, PAINT AND MARKINGS)
Paint colour chart. The Hex, RGB, CMYK and HSB values are transcribed without correction, even where the source contains values that do not agree.

Colour | White | Blue | Yellow
Hex | #FFFFFF | #0C18F0 | #F7B225
RGB | 255,255,255 | 12,24,240 | 247,178,37
CMYK | 0,0,0,0 | 95,90,0,6 | 0,28,85,3
HSB | 0,0,100 | 237,95,94 | 40,85,3

Warning lights, paint and markings — the original annex includes separate design drawings and display instructions:
(a) Passenger patrol car (highway, traffic and 112). Drawing. Markings: (1) logo on bonnet and both front doors; (2) lettering in the center of both side doors (“경찰 POLICE”), on boot/trunk (“POLICE”), and station-specific numbers on the rear sides; (3) rectangular warning-light bar.
(b) Multipurpose patrol car (112). Drawing. Markings: (1) logo on bonnet and both front doors; (2) words in the center of both side doors (“경찰 POLICE”), on boot/trunk (“POLICE”), and station-specific numbers on the rear sides; (3) rectangular warning-light bar.
(c) Passenger van (criminal patrol, forensic investigation, escort, accident investigation, etc.). Drawing. Markings: (1) logo on bonnet and at the middle of both sides; (2) use/purpose label on both front doors, “경찰” at the rear sides, and station-specific numbers on the rear sides; (3) rectangular warning-light bar.
(d) Cargo vehicle (transport of goods, etc.). Drawing. Markings: (1) logo on bonnet; (2) “POLICE 경찰” on both front doors.
(e) Medium or large passenger vehicle (police transport, police operations, etc.). Drawing. Markings: (1) logo on front bonnet and both sides; (2) large vehicles: “경찰” at front and “POLICE” at rear and sides; medium vehicles: “경찰” at the rear and sides, according to the original design.
(f) Motorcycle (traffic patrol or crime prevention). Drawing. Markings: (1) logo on front fairing/bonnet; (2) front mudguard “POLICE”, rear mudguard “경찰”; (3) warning lights.

5. KOREA COAST GUARD CARS AND MOTORCYCLES (WARNING LIGHTS, PAINT AND MARKINGS)
Paint colour chart. The values follow the printed Korean-source chart, including any inconsistencies.

CMYK | 0,0,0,0 | 0,97,98,20 | 0,10,96,5 | 43,41,0,80 | 100,0,23,54
HSB | 0,0,100 | 0,98,80 | 54,95,95 | 237,43,20 | 166,100,46

Warning lights, paint and markings:
(a) Passenger patrol car. Drawing. Logo on bonnet, both front doors, and left or middle of boot/trunk. Lettering “POLICE” at the center of both side doors, station name at right rear, “122” on both rear sides. Rectangular warning-light bar, searchlight and similar equipment.
(b) Multipurpose patrol car. Drawing. Same logo positions on bonnet, both front doors and left/middle of boot/trunk; “POLICE” on both side doors, station name at right rear, “122” on both rear sides; rectangular warning-light bar and searchlight.
(c) 122 ambulance. Drawing. Logo on bonnet, both front doors and left/middle of boot/trunk. “해양경찰” to the left and right of front logo, purpose label at the middle of both doors, station name at right rear, “122” on both rear sides. Warning lights and related equipment.
(d) Passenger van (criminal field operations, forensic investigation, etc.). Drawing. Logo on bonnet, both front doors or the center of the sides, and left/middle of boot/trunk. “해양경찰” to either side of front logo, purpose label and “POLICE” on the rear sides, station name on right rear. Rectangular warning bar, searchlight and related equipment.
(e) Cargo vehicle (special police EOD, etc.). Drawing. Logo on bonnet, both sides, and left/middle of boot/trunk. “해양경찰” beside front logo, purpose label and “POLICE” on rear sides, station name at right rear. Rectangular warning-light bar, searchlight and related equipment.
(f) Medium/large passenger vehicle (transport, rescue, police operations, etc.). Drawing. Logo on bonnet, both sides and left/middle of boot/trunk. “해양경찰” beside front logo; purpose label and “POLICE” on rear sides, station name at right rear and “122” on both rear sides. Rectangular warning-light bar, searchlight and related equipment.
(g) Medium/large tanker vehicle. Drawing. Logo on bonnet, sides and left/middle of rear. “해양경찰” beside front logo; purpose label and “POLICE” on rear sides; station name at right rear. Rectangular warning-light bar, searchlight and related equipment.
(h) Motorcycle (patrol). Drawing. Logo on front fairing and rear. “해양경찰” to either side of front and rear logos, “POLICE” on both rear sides. Warning lights, equipment box and related equipment.

Warning lights, paint and markings:
(a) Patrol car. Drawing. (1) Logo on front bonnet and boot/trunk. (2) “JEJU MUNICIPAL POLICE” on bonnet and both side doors; on boot/trunk “JEJU MUNICIPAL POLICE” and “자치경찰”; “자치경찰” on both rear sides and on the back of the warning-light bar. (3) Rectangular warning-light bar.
(b) Motorcycle (traffic or crime prevention). Drawing. (1) Logo on front screen and on the side bags (side and rear). (2) “MUNICIPAL POLICE” on front mudguard, front upper cowl and rear top box; “JEJU MUNICIPAL POLICE” and “자치경찰” on side bags. (3) Warning lights.

Note on graphics: The original Annex 1 includes visual design panels under each “Drawing” entry. This translated textual schedule preserves their references and their written specifications; it does not reproduce or replace the original drawings. The original source is identified separately by its source-text and source-XML SHA-256 hashes.
